subject.title: fix(doctor): skip groupAllowFrom migration for schemaless external channels

question: Should OpenClaw core doctor leave schemaless external channel config untouched during the groupAllowFrom fallback migration, or require a new external plugin opt-in contract first?
rationale: The bug is real and the patch is narrow, but the remaining choice changes a released upgrade repair default for external plugins whose schemas core cannot see.

options.title: Accept Schema-Verified Core Writes
options.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree core doctor must not write groupAllowFrom when generated schema metadata is missing.

options.title: Add External Opt-In Contract
options.body: Pause this fix and design a plugin doctor or schema capability so external channels can opt into this migration safely.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Protection
options.body: Close or supersede only if broader config-protection work lands the same email/RCS regression behavior and focused coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept Schema-Verified Core Writes
recommendation.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree core doctor must not write groupAllowFrom when generated schema metadata is missing.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced and merged the fallback migration being repaired, so it is the strongest routing signal for the compatibility-boundary choice.
